sessions.topic: Test prototype-based detection of unfamiliar anatomy on held-out scanners
sessions.boundary_reason: The detection criteria are met and prototype novelty scoring is retained; attention shifts to boundary calibration.

sessions.topic: Calibrate and audit boundary uncertainty against annotator disagreement
sessions.boundary_reason: The boundary-uncertainty audit reports its correlation and Dice results; the next discussion tests prototype stability across scanners.

sessions.topic: Measure cross-scanner stability of anatomy prototypes
sessions.boundary_reason: Familiar-tissue distance shifts exceed the proposed limit, motivating an alignment approach.
Alignment results are available; the next discussion introduces a different segmenter.

sessions.topic: Train a dual-head flow segmenter using scanner-conditioned alignment
sessions.boundary_reason: FlowSeg v1 is packaged, and the next discussion evaluates whether it meets the performance targets.

sessions.topic: Evaluate FlowSeg and fine-tune its boundary head
sessions.boundary_reason: Ranking-loss fine-tuning addresses the initial boundary-correlation shortfall; the next step is a direct model comparison.

sessions.topic: Compare tuned FlowSeg with BrainMRI-Cal and select FlowSeg
sessions.boundary_reason: The comparison leads to a model choice; the next discussion explores diffusion as an alternative.

sessions.topic: Test diffusion-based novelty detection on unseen scanners
sessions.boundary_reason: Novelty false-positive and small-cavity results are reported; boundary uncertainty remains a separate test.

sessions.topic: Test diffusion boundary uncertainty and decide whether to retain FlowSeg
sessions.boundary_reason: Diffusion misses the boundary and Dice targets, so FlowSeg is retained; the next discussion proposes combining their components.

sessions.topic: Build diffusion-residual novelty gating for frozen FlowSeg
sessions.boundary_reason: GatedFlowSeg v1 is packaged; the next discussion audits its held-out-scanner performance.

sessions.topic: Audit GatedFlowSeg and decide whether to adopt it
sessions.boundary_reason: The comparative audits support adopting GatedFlowSeg; the next stage tests independent vendor cohorts.
